items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: And Benny would come in, then I'd play a ...[YAWNS]... and I'd take a solo, and then Benny would get there and he'd take over and gave his solos.

ctx.x: He'd come in late, too, sometimes -- 30 minutes late, something like that. But always the band would start up, some of the boys, the older men in the band... There was a trumpet player, he'd start the band off on time. And Benny would come in, then I'd play a ...[YAWNS]... and I'd take a solo, and then Benny would get there and he'd take over and gave his solos. In other words, they had to fix it where they had the best numbers where he played his best solo... They wouldn't play them until he got there. That's…
How long were you with Redman?
